questions.stem: 生活在多數工作都得久坐的時代，許多上班族一天坐著的時間超過八小時。
questions.answer: Living in an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting, many office workers remain seated for over eight hours a day.
accepted_answers: Living in an age in which most jobs require people to sit for long periods, many office workers sit for more than eight hours a day.
Living in a time when most jobs involve sitting for hours, many office workers spend more than eight hours a day in their seats.

questions.stem: 許多研究人員開始懷疑，久坐不動對身體健康的危害是否比抽菸還要嚴重。
questions.answer: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether sitting still for long periods is even more harmful to our physical health than smoking.
accepted_answers: Many researchers have started to question whether the harm that sitting for long hours does to our physical health is greater than that of smoking.
Many researchers have begun to ask whether sitting for hours without moving is more harmful to physical health than smoking is.

1.explanation_zh: 句首「生活在…」沒有主詞，主詞和後面的「上班族」相同，用分詞構句 Living in …。「多數工作都得久坐的時代」修飾 era，子句裡缺的是時間，用關係副詞 when（＝in which）：an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting；工作本身不會坐，要寫 require (people) to sit。「一天…超過八小時」是 for over eight hours a day。
evidence: 多數工作都得久坐的時代
1.strategy_zh: 句首沒有主詞的動作片語，若和主要子句同一個主詞，就用 V-ing 分詞構句；修飾時間、地點的子句用 when／where。
hints: 切成四段：生活在／多數工作都得久坐的時代／許多上班族／一天坐著的時間超過八小時
標的詞彙：era（時代）、require（需要）、office worker（上班族）、sit（坐）、hour（小時）
句型框架：Living in an era when + S + V …, S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「懷疑…是否…」是 wonder／question whether + 直述句（不是 suspect）；「開始懷疑」用 have begun to。whether 子句的主詞是「久坐不動」這個動作，用動名詞 sitting still for long periods；把「危害…嚴重」改成形容詞比較級 more harmful to … than smoking，比較對象 sitting 和 smoking 都用動名詞才對等。
evidence: 許多研究人員開始懷疑
2.strategy_zh: 「懷疑是否」先想 wonder whether；比較句寫完後檢查 than 前後的比較對象是不是同一類（動名詞對動名詞）。
hints: 切成四段：許多研究人員開始懷疑／久坐不動／對身體健康的危害／比抽菸還要嚴重
標的詞彙：researcher（研究人員）、wonder（想知道、懷疑）、sit（坐）、harmful（有害的）、health（健康）、smoke（抽菸）
句型框架：S + have begun to wonder whether + V-ing … is more + adj. + to … than + V-ing

references: Living in an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting, many office workers remain seated for over eight hours a day.
Living in an age in which most jobs require people to sit for long periods, many office workers sit for more than eight hours a day.
Living in a time when most jobs involve sitting for hours, many office workers spend more than eight hours a day in their seats.

patterns.label_zh: 分詞構句（以分詞片語取代副詞子句）

patterns.zh_trigger: 多數工作都得久坐的時代

accepted: Living in
As they live in

common_errors.explanation_zh: 沒有主詞的「生活在…」放句首要用分詞構句 Living …；原形 Live 會變成祈使句。
主詞（上班族）是主動「生活」，用現在分詞 Living，不用過去分詞。

parts.zh: 多數工作都得久坐的時代
accepted: an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting
an age in which most jobs require people to sit for long periods
a time when most jobs involve sitting for hours
an age in which most jobs require long hours of sitting
an era when most jobs require people to sit for long hours

common_errors.wrong: an era which most jobs require long hours of sitting
common_errors.right: an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting
common_errors.explanation_zh: 關係子句裡主詞、受詞都有了，缺的是「時間」，要用關係副詞 when（＝in which），不能用 which。

common_errors.wrong: an era when most jobs need to sit for a long time
common_errors.right: an era when most jobs require people to sit for a long time
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「工作」不會坐；要寫 jobs require people to sit 或 jobs require long hours of sitting。

accepted: many office workers
many employees
many white-collar workers

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「上班族」是 office workers 或 employees，不要逐字翻。

parts.zh: 一天坐著的時間超過八小時
accepted: remain seated for over eight hours a day
sit for more than eight hours a day
spend more than eight hours a day in their seats
sit for over eight hours a day
spend over eight hours a day sitting

common_errors.wrong: sit over eight hours one day
common_errors.right: sit for over eight hours a day
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「一天…小時」是 … hours a day（a＝每）；時間長度前常加 for。

common_errors.wrong: spend more than eight hours a day to sit
common_errors.right: spend more than eight hours a day sitting
common_errors.explanation_zh: spend + 時間 + V-ing，不接 to V。

traps.literal_error: Live in an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting, many office workers …
traps.explanation_zh: 句首「生活在…」沒有主詞，英文不能直接用原形動詞開頭；用分詞構句 Living in …（意義主詞是後面的 office workers），或改成 As they live in …。

traps.zh: 多數工作都得久坐的時代
traps.literal_error: Living in most jobs must sit for a long time era, …
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾「時代」的子句要放在名詞後面，用關係副詞 when：an era when most jobs require long hours of sitting。

bonus.text: Living in an era when most jobs chain people to their desks, many office workers remain seated for over eight hours a day.
bonus.explanation_zh: chain sb to the desk（把人綁在辦公桌前）是生動的比喻寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 句首「生活在…的時代」沒有主詞，英文用分詞構句 Living in …，意義主詞就是後面的 many office workers；「多數工作都得久坐」不能寫成工作會坐，要改成 most jobs require long hours of sitting（或 require people to sit）。

references: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether sitting still for long periods is even more harmful to our physical health than smoking.
Many researchers have started to question whether the harm that sitting for long hours does to our physical health is greater than that of smoking.
Many researchers have begun to ask whether sitting for hours without moving is more harmful to physical health than smoking is.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）
patterns.frame: S + V + whether + S + V（直述句語序）
A + be + more + adj. + to … + than + B

parts.zh: 許多研究人員開始懷疑
accepted: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether
Many researchers have started to question whether
Many researchers have begun to ask whether
Many researchers have started to wonder if
Many scientists have begun to wonder whether

common_errors.wrong: Many researchers begin to suspect whether
common_errors.right: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether
common_errors.explanation_zh: suspect 是「認為可能是」，接 that 子句；「懷疑是否」用 wonder／question whether。「開始懷疑」是到現在的狀態，常用現在完成式 have begun。

common_errors.wrong: Many researchers have begun to doubt that
common_errors.right: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether
common_errors.explanation_zh: doubt that 是「不相信…」，和「懷疑是否」語意不同；用 wonder／question whether。

accepted: sitting still for long periods
the harm that sitting for long hours does
sitting for hours without moving
sitting for long periods
sitting still for hours

common_errors.wrong: sit for a long time is
common_errors.right: sitting for a long time is
common_errors.explanation_zh: whether 子句的主詞是「久坐」這個動作，要用動名詞 sitting。
時間長度前要加 for（for a long time／for long periods）。

accepted: is even more harmful to our physical health
to our physical health is greater
is more harmful to physical health
is more harmful to our health
is more damaging to our health

common_errors.wrong: is more harm to our health
common_errors.right: is more harmful to our health
common_errors.explanation_zh: be 動詞後要用形容詞 harmful；harm 是名詞或動詞。

common_errors.wrong: is more harmful for our health
common_errors.right: is more harmful to our health
common_errors.explanation_zh: harmful 搭配介系詞 to（be harmful to …）。

accepted: than smoking
than that of smoking
than smoking is
than smoking does

common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較的對象要對等：前面是 sitting（動名詞），後面也用動名詞 smoking。
重複的名詞用 that 代替（than that of smoking），smoke 也要改成動名詞 smoking。

traps.literal_error: Many researchers begin to suspect whether …
traps.explanation_zh: 「懷疑是否」是 wonder／question whether；suspect 是「懷疑某事可能是真的」，接 that 子句，意思相反。

traps.literal_error: … whether the danger of sitting still to physical health is more serious than smoking.
traps.explanation_zh: 照字面以「危害」當主詞，容易寫成比較對象不對等（危害 vs. 抽菸）；用形容詞 harmful 改寫最簡潔：sitting … is more harmful to our health than smoking。

bonus.text: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether prolonged sitting poses an even greater threat to our health than smoking.
bonus.explanation_zh: prolonged sitting（長時間久坐）、pose a threat to（對…構成威脅）是更正式的學術寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「久坐不動對身體健康的危害是否比抽菸還要嚴重」以「危害」當主詞，英文改用動作當主詞、形容詞當補語：whether sitting still … is more harmful to our health than smoking，比較對象 sitting／smoking 才對等。

1.translation: Living in an era when most jobs require people to sit for long hours, many office workers spend more than eight hours a day sitting.
1.explanation_zh: 「生活在…的時代」用分詞構句 Living in an era when ...，邏輯主詞是 many office workers；「多數工作都得久坐」用 most jobs require people to sit for long hours；「一天坐著的時間超過八小時」用 spend + 時間 + V-ing。

2.translation: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether sitting for long periods is even more harmful to our health than smoking.
2.explanation_zh: 「開始懷疑…是否」配「是否」，讀成「想知道／質疑是否」，用 have begun to wonder whether；若把「懷疑」讀成 suspect（認為可能是），則會寫 have begun to suspect that ...，兩種讀法都說得通；「危害…比抽菸還要嚴重」用 even more harmful to ... than smoking（也可寫 the harm ... is even more serious than that of smoking）。

issues_zh: （說明）「開始懷疑…是否」可讀成 wonder／question whether，也可讀成 suspect that（認為可能是），意思接近；參考譯文都用 whether，和我的譯文一致。

1.translation: Living in an age when most jobs require people to sit for long periods, many office workers sit for more than eight hours a day.
1.explanation_zh: 「生活在……的時代」用分詞片語 Living in an age when ...；主要子句主詞 many office workers 與分詞的動作者一致；超過八小時用 more than eight hours a day。

2.translation: Many researchers have begun to wonder whether sitting for long periods does even more harm to our health than smoking.
2.explanation_zh: 「開始懷疑」用 have begun to wonder whether；「危害是否比……還要嚴重」改用 does even more harm ... than smoking 的比較結構，不照字面把 harm 當主詞，所以信心中等。
